title: drift_report
description: Output of a drift detection run. Written by detect_drift.py when Trigger 3 activates — either via the trigger cascade or manual invocation.

report_id.description: Unique identifier for this drift report (e.g. 'drift_20260611_001')

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this report was generated

triggered_by.description: What caused this drift report to be generated

trigger_1_findings.description: Results of the lightweight Phase 4 entry scan

ran.description: Whether Trigger 1 ran as part of this report

passed.description: True means Trigger 1 detected one or more signals and drift is suspected — action is needed. False means no signals fired — project looks unchanged.

new_file_extensions.description: File extensions that appear now but were absent from the snapshot

new_top_level_directories.description: Top-level directories that appear now but were absent from the snapshot

stack_files_changed.description: Stack-defining files that changed since the snapshot

file_count_growth_percent.description: Percentage growth in total file count since snapshot. Null if not calculated.

signals_fired.description: Plain-language description of each signal that fired

trigger_2_findings.description: Results of the commit weight analysis

passed.description: True means the commit weight threshold was crossed and drift was detected — action is needed. False means weight is still below threshold — no action yet.

accumulated_weight.description: Total commit weight accumulated since last snapshot

weight_threshold.description: Threshold from config.json that was used

commits_analyzed.description: Breakdown of commits that contributed weight

reason.description: Plain-language explanation of why this commit received its weight

agent_assessment.description: Agent interpretation of what changed based on all evidence gathered

summary.description: Plain-language summary of what the agent believes changed in the project

suspected_changes.description: Specific suspected changes stated plainly (e.g. 'A REST API layer may have been added')

skills_possibly_affected.description: Names of skills that may need review based on the detected changes

mcps_possibly_affected.description: Names of MCPs that may need review based on the detected changes

user_questions.description: Targeted questions presented to the user — one per detected signal

signal.description: The specific signal this question addresses

question.description: The exact question asked to the user

user_answer.description: The user's response. Null until answered.

answered.description: Whether the user has responded to this question

user_exceptions.description: Signals the user marked as non-significant. These are excluded from rerun recommendations and the weight counter is reset.

rerun_recommendations.description: Per-phase rerun recommendations based on drift findings and user responses

reason.description: Plain-language explanation of why Phase 1 should or should not be rerun

status.description: Current state of this drift report. Starts as pending_user_response and resolves once the user answers all questions.

resolved_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the user responded to all questions and the report was resolved. Null until resolved.
